cohort: A study of 75 women with twin pregnancies diagnosed clinically and confirmed by ultrasound with a gestation >28 weeks.
finding: Perinatal morbidity in twin 2 is higher than twin 1, and is significantly associated with Pre-Term delivery, Chorionicity of DCDA, mode of delivery, and APGAR score at 1 minute.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with NICU admission for twin 2, with vaginal delivery being the commonest mode for both twin 1 (78.7%) and twin 2 (70.7%).
cross-section timing: During the hospital stay, covering intra-partum management and neonatal characteristics around the time of birth.
gest_age: Included pregnancies with gestation >28 weeks, with a mean gestational age of 35.55 weeks.
